column3: MT 4:30. Close to the Aramaic; NKJV supplies “feathers” and “claws” (“like eagles’ feathers … like birds’ claws”).
MT 4:32. Close to the Aramaic; “who will strike on his hand” is rendered “No one can restrain His hand.”
MT 4:33. Close to the Aramaic; “my understanding” is rendered “my reason,” and “they sought me” “resorted to me.”
